figurative_meaning_en: Time of calamity; time of death
example_sentences_in_bangla: যুদ্ধের আসন্নকালে সকলে ভয় পেয়ে গেল।
তার জীবনের আসন্নকাল অনুভব করে সে প্রস্তুত হলো।
example_sentences_in_english: In the impending doom of war, everyone was gripped by fear.
Sensing the time of death approaching, he prepared himself.
note: The idiom is derived from classical Bengali literature and evokes a sense of inevitable crisis.
